theme: Light theme (warm, organic, vintage bakery vibe with a modern layout).

headings.usage: Use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) for large headers. Never use generic sans-serif for headings to maintain the rustic, artisanal brand voice.

body.usage: Use leading-relaxed for body text to ensure maximum legibility, contrasting the classic serif headings.

colors.rules: Match the provided logo: Base text is rich dark brown. Base background is warm cream/off-white. Accent color is soft pink for highlights or secondary CTAs. Gold/Wheat for borders or active states.

visual_enhancers.textures: Include subtle noise overlays or warm gradients in hero sections to emulate a tactile, flour-dusted, homemade feel.

component_strategy.marketing_pages: Use pure HTML/Tailwind for layouts. Implement generous spacing (p-12 to p-24) and asymmetrical image placements to keep it organic, avoiding stiff Shadcn cards for front-end product storytelling.
component_strategy.admin_dashboard: Use Shadcn UI primitives extensively. Build dense bento grids (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4), tight spacing (p-4 to p-6), functional and clear hierarchy.
component_strategy.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) for primary marketing CTAs, utilizing solid dark brown background with cream text. Admin buttons can use standard sm/md radii.
component_strategy.navigation: Sticky glassmorphism header (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#F9F6F0]/80 border-b border-[#4A3022]/10) to ensure the logo and links remain visible over hero sections.

grids_and_layouts.marketing_grid: Asymmetrical 'Tetris' grid for category features (e.g. gap-8 to gap-12, mixing col-span-8 and col-span-4).
grids_and_layouts.dashboard_grid: High density (gap-4 or gap-6) strict hierarchy. Full utilization of screen real-estate for Inventory, Orders, and Metrics.
grids_and_layouts.alignment: Left-align dense text and labels. Optical alignment for icons inside buttons.

motion.hover_states: Slight lift (-translate-y-1) and shadow expansion (shadow-md) for product cards and primary buttons.
motion.transitions: Use specific transitions: transition-transform duration-300 ease-out, transition-opacity duration-200. NO universal transition-all.
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-in-up for product grids and list items.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over images has sufficient contrast. Use gradient overlays (bg-gradient-to-t from-[#4A3022]/80 to-transparent) on bottom of images if text is overlaid.
accessibility.focus: Focus states must use ring-2 ring-[#4A3022] outline-none on all interactive elements.

media.image_rules: Never use placeholder URLs. Preserve image aspect ratios with object-cover. Use max-h-[80vh] for hero images on mobile.

instructions_to_main_agent: You MUST write valid .js files, NOT .tsx files.
Do NOT use HTML-based components for advanced user interactions (dropdown, calendar, toast). Use Shadcn UI logic wrapped in custom Tailwind styling.
Include data-testid attributes on ALL interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='add-to-cart-button', data-testid='category-filter-cakes', data-testid='admin-login-button').
Never use generic Emojis (e.g. 🤖, 🍞). Use lucide-react icons for UI elements.
DO NOT use a complete transparent background in headers, overlays, or dropdowns. ALWAYS use glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl + bg-opacity) or solid background.
Ensure 'orders@cafedailycravings.com' is explicitly visible on the Contact page and Global Footer.
Never use placeholder image URLs like via.placeholder.com. Use the provided high-end image_urls.
Use Lucide-React for standard icons (already installed).
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e., do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, custom selection states, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui. Check them before building from scratch.
GENERAL_UI_UX_DESIGN_GUIDELINES: Prioritize clear user pathways: Admin pathways must be strictly separated from E-commerce pathways visually.
All forms (Contact, Inquiry, Checkout) must have clear validation states and error messages.
Product pages must state clear lead times, pickup windows, and available customizations.
Use high-contrast visual cues for Admin Dashboard stock alerts and new orders.
Include empty states for Cart, Orders, and Inquiries with helpful CTAs.
